metrics.name: Total GMV
metrics.description: Total gross merchandise value across all orders.
metrics.valueSql: SELECT SUM(gmv_inr) AS value FROM orders
metrics.timeSeriesSql: SELECT CAST(order_ts AS DATE) AS date, SUM(gmv_inr) AS value FROM orders GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY date

metrics.name: Total Orders
metrics.description: Count of all orders placed regardless of final status.
metrics.valueSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS value FROM orders
metrics.timeSeriesSql: SELECT CAST(order_ts AS DATE) AS date, COUNT(*) AS value FROM orders GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY date

metrics.name: Delivered Orders
metrics.description: Count of orders with delivered status.
metrics.valueSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS value FROM orders WHERE order_status = 'Delivered'
metrics.timeSeriesSql: SELECT CAST(order_ts AS DATE) AS date, COUNT(*) AS value FROM orders WHERE order_status = 'Delivered' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY date

metrics.name: Order Completion Rate
metrics.description: Share of orders that were delivered.
metrics.valueSql: SELECT CAST(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE order_status = 'Delivered') AS DOUBLE) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS value FROM orders
metrics.timeSeriesSql: SELECT CAST(order_ts AS DATE) AS date, CAST(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE order_status = 'Delivered') AS DOUBLE) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS value FROM orders GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY date

metrics.name: Cancelled Orders
metrics.description: Count of orders cancelled before completion.
metrics.valueSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS value FROM orders WHERE order_status = 'Cancelled'
metrics.timeSeriesSql: SELECT CAST(order_ts AS DATE) AS date, COUNT(*) AS value FROM orders WHERE order_status = 'Cancelled' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY date

metrics.name: Cancellation Rate
metrics.description: Share of all orders that were cancelled.
metrics.valueSql: SELECT CAST(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE order_status = 'Cancelled') AS DOUBLE) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS value FROM orders
metrics.timeSeriesSql: SELECT CAST(order_ts AS DATE) AS date, CAST(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE order_status = 'Cancelled') AS DOUBLE) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS value FROM orders GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY date

metrics.name: Marketplace Commission Revenue
metrics.description: Total marketplace take-rate revenue earned from order items.
metrics.valueSql: SELECT SUM(commission_inr) AS value FROM order_items
metrics.timeSeriesSql: SELECT CAST(order_ts AS DATE) AS date, SUM(commission_inr) AS value FROM order_items GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY date

metrics.name: Total Payment Amount
metrics.description: Total amount attempted or collected in payments including shipping and net of discounts.
metrics.valueSql: SELECT SUM(amount_inr) AS value FROM payments
metrics.timeSeriesSql: SELECT CAST(payment_ts AS DATE) AS date, SUM(amount_inr) AS value FROM payments GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY date

metrics.name: Total Refund Amount
metrics.description: Total refund amount issued for returns.
metrics.valueSql: SELECT SUM(refund_inr) AS value FROM returns
metrics.timeSeriesSql: SELECT CAST(requested_ts AS DATE) AS date, SUM(refund_inr) AS value FROM returns GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY date

metrics.name: Net GMV After Refunds
metrics.description: GMV net of refund amounts from returns.
metrics.valueSql: SELECT (SELECT SUM(gmv_inr) FROM orders) - COALESCE((SELECT SUM(refund_inr) FROM returns), 0) AS value
metrics.timeSeriesSql: SELECT d.date AS date, COALESCE(g.gmv, 0) - COALESCE(r.refunds, 0) AS value FROM (SELECT date FROM (SELECT CAST(order_ts AS DATE) AS date FROM orders UNION SELECT CAST(requested_ts AS DATE) AS date FROM returns) u GROUP BY 1) d LEFT JOIN (SELECT CAST(order_ts AS DATE) AS date, SUM(gmv_inr) AS gmv FROM orders GROUP BY 1) g ON d.date = g.date LEFT JOIN (SELECT CAST(requested_ts AS DATE) AS date, SUM(refund_inr) AS refunds FROM returns GROUP BY 1) r ON d.date = r.date ORDER BY date

metrics.name: Monthly Active Buyers
metrics.description: Distinct buyers who placed at least one order in a month.
metrics.valueSql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) AS value FROM orders
metrics.timeSeriesSql: SELECT strftime(order_ts, '%Y-%m') AS date, COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) AS value FROM orders GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY date

metrics.name: Total Sessions
metrics.description: Count of browsing sessions across the platform.
metrics.valueSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS value FROM sessions
metrics.timeSeriesSql: SELECT CAST(session_ts AS DATE) AS date, COUNT(*) AS value FROM sessions GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY date

metrics.name: Average Order Value
metrics.description: Average GMV per order.
metrics.valueSql: SELECT AVG(gmv_inr) AS value FROM orders
metrics.timeSeriesSql: SELECT CAST(order_ts AS DATE) AS date, AVG(gmv_inr) AS value FROM orders GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY date

metrics.name: Average Items per Order
metrics.description: Average number of items in each order.
metrics.valueSql: SELECT AVG(items_count) AS value FROM orders
metrics.timeSeriesSql: SELECT CAST(order_ts AS DATE) AS date, AVG(items_count) AS value FROM orders GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY date

metrics.name: Average Discount per Order
metrics.description: Average discount amount applied per order.
metrics.valueSql: SELECT AVG(discount_inr) AS value FROM orders
metrics.timeSeriesSql: SELECT CAST(order_ts AS DATE) AS date, AVG(discount_inr) AS value FROM orders GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY date

metrics.name: Average Shipping Fee
metrics.description: Average shipping fee charged per order.
metrics.valueSql: SELECT AVG(shipping_fee_inr) AS value FROM orders
metrics.timeSeriesSql: SELECT CAST(order_ts AS DATE) AS date, AVG(shipping_fee_inr) AS value FROM orders GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY date

metrics.name: On-Time Delivery Rate
metrics.description: Share of delivered orders that met the promised SLA.
metrics.valueSql: SELECT CAST(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE sla_met_flag = TRUE AND order_status = 'Delivered') AS DOUBLE) / NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE order_status = 'Delivered'), 0) AS value FROM orders
metrics.timeSeriesSql: SELECT CAST(order_ts AS DATE) AS date, CAST(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE sla_met_flag = TRUE AND order_status = 'Delivered') AS DOUBLE) / NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE order_status = 'Delivered'), 0) AS value FROM orders GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY date
metrics.formula: COUNT(Delivered orders with sla_met_flag=TRUE) / COUNT(Delivered orders)

metrics.name: Average Delivery Delay Days
metrics.description: Average difference between actual and promised delivery days for delivered orders.
metrics.valueSql: SELECT AVG(CAST(delivery_actual_days - delivery_promised_days AS DOUBLE)) AS value FROM orders WHERE order_status = 'Delivered'
metrics.timeSeriesSql: SELECT CAST(order_ts AS DATE) AS date, AVG(CAST(delivery_actual_days - delivery_promised_days AS DOUBLE)) AS value FROM orders WHERE order_status = 'Delivered' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY date

metrics.name: Average Unit Price
metrics.description: Average listed unit selling price per order item.
metrics.valueSql: SELECT AVG(unit_price_inr) AS value FROM order_items
metrics.timeSeriesSql: SELECT CAST(order_ts AS DATE) AS date, AVG(unit_price_inr) AS value FROM order_items GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY date

metrics.name: Average Item Discount
metrics.description: Average item-level discount per order line.
metrics.valueSql: SELECT AVG(item_discount_inr) AS value FROM order_items
metrics.timeSeriesSql: SELECT CAST(order_ts AS DATE) AS date, AVG(item_discount_inr) AS value FROM order_items GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY date

metrics.name: Average Payment Amount
metrics.description: Average payment amount per order-level payment record.
metrics.valueSql: SELECT AVG(amount_inr) AS value FROM payments
metrics.timeSeriesSql: SELECT CAST(payment_ts AS DATE) AS date, AVG(amount_inr) AS value FROM payments GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY date

metrics.name: Successful Payment Rate
metrics.description: Share of payments that are successful or collected.
metrics.valueSql: SELECT CAST(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE payment_status IN ('Success', 'Collected')) AS DOUBLE) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS value FROM payments
metrics.timeSeriesSql: SELECT CAST(payment_ts AS DATE) AS date, CAST(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE payment_status IN ('Success', 'Collected')) AS DOUBLE) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS value FROM payments GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY date
metrics.formula: COUNT(payments with status Success or Collected) / COUNT(all payments)

metrics.name: Product View Rate
metrics.description: Share of sessions in which a product was viewed.
metrics.valueSql: SELECT CAST(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE viewed_product_flag = TRUE) AS DOUBLE) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS value FROM sessions
metrics.timeSeriesSql: SELECT CAST(session_ts AS DATE) AS date, CAST(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE viewed_product_flag = TRUE) AS DOUBLE) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS value FROM sessions GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY date

metrics.name: Cart Add Rate
metrics.description: Share of sessions that added at least one product to cart.
metrics.valueSql: SELECT CAST(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE added_to_cart_flag = TRUE) AS DOUBLE) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS value FROM sessions
metrics.timeSeriesSql: SELECT CAST(session_ts AS DATE) AS date, CAST(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE added_to_cart_flag = TRUE) AS DOUBLE) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS value FROM sessions GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY date

metrics.name: Checkout Start Rate
metrics.description: Share of sessions that reached checkout.
metrics.valueSql: SELECT CAST(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE started_checkout_flag = TRUE) AS DOUBLE) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS value FROM sessions
metrics.timeSeriesSql: SELECT CAST(session_ts AS DATE) AS date, CAST(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE started_checkout_flag = TRUE) AS DOUBLE) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS value FROM sessions GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY date

metrics.name: Session to Order Conversion Rate
metrics.description: Share of sessions that resulted in an order placement.
metrics.valueSql: SELECT CAST(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE placed_order_flag = TRUE) AS DOUBLE) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS value FROM sessions
metrics.timeSeriesSql: SELECT CAST(session_ts AS DATE) AS date, CAST(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE placed_order_flag = TRUE) AS DOUBLE) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS value FROM sessions GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY date

metrics.name: Cart Abandonment Rate
metrics.description: Share of cart sessions that did not result in an order.
metrics.valueSql: SELECT CAST(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE added_to_cart_flag = TRUE AND placed_order_flag = FALSE) AS DOUBLE) / NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE added_to_cart_flag = TRUE), 0) AS value FROM sessions
metrics.timeSeriesSql: SELECT CAST(session_ts AS DATE) AS date, CAST(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE added_to_cart_flag = TRUE AND placed_order_flag = FALSE) AS DOUBLE) / NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE added_to_cart_flag = TRUE), 0) AS value FROM sessions GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY date

metrics.name: Return Rate
metrics.description: Share of delivered items that were returned.
metrics.valueSql: SELECT CAST(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE item_status = 'Returned') AS DOUBLE) / NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE item_status IN ('Delivered', 'Returned')), 0) AS value FROM order_items
metrics.timeSeriesSql: SELECT CAST(order_ts AS DATE) AS date, CAST(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE item_status = 'Returned') AS DOUBLE) / NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE item_status IN ('Delivered', 'Returned')), 0) AS value FROM order_items GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY date
metrics.formula: COUNT(items with status Returned) / COUNT(items with status Delivered or Returned)

metrics.name: Average Return Resolution Days
metrics.description: Average time taken to resolve returns with a recorded resolution duration.
metrics.valueSql: SELECT AVG(CAST(resolution_days AS DOUBLE)) AS value FROM returns WHERE resolution_days IS NOT NULL
metrics.timeSeriesSql: SELECT CAST(requested_ts AS DATE) AS date, AVG(CAST(resolution_days AS DOUBLE)) AS value FROM returns WHERE resolution_days IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY date

metrics.name: Return Completion Rate
metrics.description: Share of returns that have been completed.
metrics.valueSql: SELECT CAST(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE resolution = 'Completed') AS DOUBLE) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS value FROM returns
metrics.timeSeriesSql: SELECT CAST(requested_ts AS DATE) AS date, CAST(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE resolution = 'Completed') AS DOUBLE) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS value FROM returns GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY date

metrics.name: Average Review Rating
metrics.description: Average star rating across verified product reviews.
metrics.valueSql: SELECT AVG(CAST(rating AS DOUBLE)) AS value FROM reviews WHERE verified_purchase_flag = TRUE
metrics.timeSeriesSql: SELECT CAST(review_ts AS DATE) AS date, AVG(CAST(rating AS DOUBLE)) AS value FROM reviews WHERE verified_purchase_flag = TRUE GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY date

metrics.name: Review Volume
metrics.description: Count of product reviews submitted.
metrics.valueSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS value FROM reviews
metrics.timeSeriesSql: SELECT CAST(review_ts AS DATE) AS date, COUNT(*) AS value FROM reviews GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY date

metrics.name: Negative Review Rate
metrics.description: Share of reviews with ratings of 1 or 2 stars.
metrics.valueSql: SELECT CAST(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE rating <= 2) AS DOUBLE) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS value FROM reviews
metrics.timeSeriesSql: SELECT CAST(review_ts AS DATE) AS date, CAST(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE rating <= 2) AS DOUBLE) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS value FROM reviews GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY date

metrics.name: Active Sellers
metrics.description: Count of sellers currently marked active.
metrics.valueSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS value FROM sellers WHERE status = 'Active'
metrics.timeSeriesSql: SELECT strftime(onboarded_date, '%Y-%m') AS date, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'Active') AS value FROM sellers GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY date

metrics.name: Seller Count
metrics.description: Total number of sellers onboarded on the marketplace.
metrics.valueSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS value FROM sellers
metrics.timeSeriesSql: SELECT strftime(onboarded_date, '%Y-%m') AS date, COUNT(*) AS value FROM sellers GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY date

metrics.name: Seller Churn Rate
metrics.description: Share of sellers marked churned out of all sellers.
metrics.valueSql: SELECT CAST(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'Churned') AS DOUBLE) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS value FROM sellers
metrics.timeSeriesSql: SELECT strftime(onboarded_date, '%Y-%m') AS date, CAST(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'Churned') AS DOUBLE) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS value FROM sellers GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY date

metrics.name: Average Seller Rating
metrics.description: Average marketplace seller rating.
metrics.valueSql: SELECT AVG(seller_rating) AS value FROM sellers
metrics.timeSeriesSql: SELECT strftime(onboarded_date, '%Y-%m') AS date, AVG(seller_rating) AS value FROM sellers GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY date

metrics.name: Product Count
metrics.description: Total number of listed products.
metrics.valueSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS value FROM products
metrics.timeSeriesSql: SELECT strftime(launch_date, '%Y-%m') AS date, COUNT(*) AS value FROM products GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY date

metrics.name: Average Product Rating
metrics.description: Average SKU rating across the product catalog.
metrics.valueSql: SELECT AVG(rating_avg) AS value FROM products
metrics.timeSeriesSql: SELECT strftime(launch_date, '%Y-%m') AS date, AVG(rating_avg) AS value FROM products GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY date

metrics.name: Average Product Rating Count
metrics.description: Average number of ratings per product.
metrics.valueSql: SELECT AVG(CAST(rating_count AS DOUBLE)) AS value FROM products
metrics.timeSeriesSql: SELECT strftime(launch_date, '%Y-%m') AS date, AVG(CAST(rating_count AS DOUBLE)) AS value FROM products GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY date

metrics.name: Average List Price
metrics.description: Average current list price across products.
metrics.valueSql: SELECT AVG(list_price_inr) AS value FROM products
metrics.timeSeriesSql: SELECT strftime(launch_date, '%Y-%m') AS date, AVG(list_price_inr) AS value FROM products GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY date

metrics.name: Average MRP
metrics.description: Average MRP across products.
metrics.valueSql: SELECT AVG(mrp_inr) AS value FROM products
metrics.timeSeriesSql: SELECT strftime(launch_date, '%Y-%m') AS date, AVG(mrp_inr) AS value FROM products GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY date

metrics.name: Average Catalog Discount Rate
metrics.description: Average markdown from MRP to list price across the catalog.
metrics.valueSql: SELECT AVG((mrp_inr - list_price_inr) / NULLIF(mrp_inr, 0)) AS value FROM products
metrics.timeSeriesSql: SELECT strftime(launch_date, '%Y-%m') AS date, AVG((mrp_inr - list_price_inr) / NULLIF(mrp_inr, 0)) AS value FROM products GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY date

metrics.name: Total Seller Ad Spend
metrics.description: Total Flipkart Ads spend by sellers.
metrics.valueSql: SELECT SUM(spend_inr) AS value FROM ad_campaigns
metrics.timeSeriesSql: SELECT month AS date, SUM(spend_inr) AS value FROM ad_campaigns GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY date

metrics.name: Attributed Ad GMV
metrics.description: Total GMV attributed to seller ad campaigns.
metrics.valueSql: SELECT SUM(attributed_gmv_inr) AS value FROM ad_campaigns
metrics.timeSeriesSql: SELECT month AS date, SUM(attributed_gmv_inr) AS value FROM ad_campaigns GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY date

metrics.name: Attributed Orders
metrics.description: Total orders attributed to seller ad campaigns.
metrics.valueSql: SELECT SUM(attributed_orders) AS value FROM ad_campaigns
metrics.timeSeriesSql: SELECT month AS date, SUM(attributed_orders) AS value FROM ad_campaigns GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY date

metrics.name: Ad ROAS
metrics.description: Return on ad spend from seller campaigns.
metrics.valueSql: SELECT SUM(attributed_gmv_inr) / NULLIF(SUM(spend_inr), 0) AS value FROM ad_campaigns
metrics.timeSeriesSql: SELECT month AS date, SUM(attributed_gmv_inr) / NULLIF(SUM(spend_inr), 0) AS value FROM ad_campaigns GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY date

metrics.name: Average CPC
metrics.description: Blended average cost per click across seller ad campaigns.
metrics.valueSql: SELECT SUM(spend_inr) / NULLIF(SUM(clicks), 0) AS value FROM ad_campaigns
metrics.timeSeriesSql: SELECT month AS date, SUM(spend_inr) / NULLIF(SUM(clicks), 0) AS value FROM ad_campaigns GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY date

metrics.name: Ad CTR
metrics.description: Click-through rate across seller ad campaigns.
metrics.valueSql: SELECT CAST(SUM(clicks) AS DOUBLE) / NULLIF(SUM(impressions), 0) AS value FROM ad_campaigns
metrics.timeSeriesSql: SELECT month AS date, CAST(SUM(clicks) AS DOUBLE) / NULLIF(SUM(impressions), 0) AS value FROM ad_campaigns GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY date

metrics.name: Total Buyer Acquisition Spend
metrics.description: Total marketing spend to acquire buyers across channels.
metrics.valueSql: SELECT SUM(marketing_spend_inr) AS value FROM acquisition_spend
metrics.timeSeriesSql: SELECT month AS date, SUM(marketing_spend_inr) AS value FROM acquisition_spend GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY date

metrics.name: New Buyers Acquired
metrics.description: Total new buyers acquired across acquisition channels.
metrics.valueSql: SELECT SUM(new_buyers_acquired) AS value FROM acquisition_spend
metrics.timeSeriesSql: SELECT month AS date, SUM(new_buyers_acquired) AS value FROM acquisition_spend GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY date

metrics.name: Blended CAC
metrics.description: Average paid cost to acquire a new buyer across all channels.
metrics.valueSql: SELECT SUM(marketing_spend_inr) / NULLIF(SUM(new_buyers_acquired), 0) AS value FROM acquisition_spend
metrics.timeSeriesSql: SELECT month AS date, SUM(marketing_spend_inr) / NULLIF(SUM(new_buyers_acquired), 0) AS value FROM acquisition_spend GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY date

metrics.name: Buyer Acquisition CTR
metrics.description: Click-through rate on buyer acquisition marketing.
metrics.valueSql: SELECT CAST(SUM(clicks) AS DOUBLE) / NULLIF(SUM(impressions), 0) AS value FROM acquisition_spend
metrics.timeSeriesSql: SELECT month AS date, CAST(SUM(clicks) AS DOUBLE) / NULLIF(SUM(impressions), 0) AS value FROM acquisition_spend GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY date

metrics.name: Repeat Buyer Rate
metrics.description: Share of ordering buyers who placed more than one order.
metrics.valueSql: SELECT CAST(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE order_count > 1) AS DOUBLE) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS value FROM (SELECT customer_id, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders GROUP BY customer_id) t
metrics.timeSeriesSql: SELECT order_month AS date, CAST(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE cumulative_orders > 1) AS DOUBLE) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS value FROM (SELECT strftime(order_ts, '%Y-%m') AS order_month, customer_id, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY strftime(order_ts, '%Y-%m') ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_orders FROM (SELECT DISTINCT strftime(order_ts, '%Y-%m') AS order_month, customer_id FROM orders) x) t GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY date
metrics.formula: COUNT(buyers with >1 order) / COUNT(buyers with >=1 order)

metrics.name: First Order Rate
metrics.description: Share of orders that are the buyer's first ever order.
metrics.valueSql: SELECT CAST(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE is_first_order_flag = TRUE) AS DOUBLE) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS value FROM orders
metrics.timeSeriesSql: SELECT CAST(order_ts AS DATE) AS date, CAST(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE is_first_order_flag = TRUE) AS DOUBLE) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS value FROM orders GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY date

metrics.name: GMV per Active Buyer
metrics.description: Average GMV generated per distinct ordering buyer.
metrics.valueSql: SELECT SUM(gmv_inr) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id), 0) AS value FROM orders
metrics.timeSeriesSql: SELECT strftime(order_ts, '%Y-%m') AS date, SUM(gmv_inr) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id), 0) AS value FROM orders GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY date

metrics.name: Effective Take Rate
metrics.description: Commission revenue as a share of line GMV.
metrics.valueSql: SELECT SUM(commission_inr) / NULLIF(SUM(line_gmv_inr), 0) AS value FROM order_items
metrics.timeSeriesSql: SELECT CAST(order_ts AS DATE) AS date, SUM(commission_inr) / NULLIF(SUM(line_gmv_inr), 0) AS value FROM order_items GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY date

metrics.name: Attributed AOV from Ads
metrics.description: Average attributed GMV per attributed order from seller ads.
metrics.valueSql: SELECT SUM(attributed_gmv_inr) / NULLIF(SUM(attributed_orders), 0) AS value FROM ad_campaigns
metrics.timeSeriesSql: SELECT month AS date, SUM(attributed_gmv_inr) / NULLIF(SUM(attributed_orders), 0) AS value FROM ad_campaigns GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY date

metrics.name: Customer Count
metrics.description: Total number of customers in the buyer base.
metrics.valueSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS value FROM customers
metrics.timeSeriesSql: SELECT strftime(signup_date, '%Y-%m') AS date, COUNT(*) AS value FROM customers GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY date

metrics.name: Average Customer Lifetime Orders
metrics.description: Average recorded lifetime orders per customer profile.
metrics.valueSql: SELECT AVG(CAST(lifetime_orders AS DOUBLE)) AS value FROM customers
metrics.timeSeriesSql: SELECT strftime(signup_date, '%Y-%m') AS date, AVG(CAST(lifetime_orders AS DOUBLE)) AS value FROM customers GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY date

metrics.name: Average Customer Lifetime GMV
metrics.description: Average recorded lifetime GMV per customer.
metrics.valueSql: SELECT AVG(lifetime_gmv_inr) AS value FROM customers
metrics.timeSeriesSql: SELECT strftime(signup_date, '%Y-%m') AS date, AVG(lifetime_gmv_inr) AS value FROM customers GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY date

metrics.name: Plus Member Rate
metrics.description: Share of customers who are Flipkart Plus members.
metrics.valueSql: SELECT CAST(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE plus_member_flag = TRUE) AS DOUBLE) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS value FROM customers
metrics.timeSeriesSql: SELECT strftime(signup_date, '%Y-%m') AS date, CAST(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE plus_member_flag = TRUE) AS DOUBLE) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS value FROM customers GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY date

metrics.name: LTV to CAC
metrics.description: Ratio of average customer lifetime GMV to blended acquisition cost.
metrics.valueSql: SELECT (SELECT AVG(lifetime_gmv_inr) FROM customers) / NULLIF((SELECT SUM(marketing_spend_inr) / NULLIF(SUM(new_buyers_acquired), 0) FROM acquisition_spend), 0) AS value
metrics.timeSeriesSql: SELECT c.month AS date, c.avg_ltv / NULLIF(a.cac, 0) AS value FROM (SELECT strftime(signup_date, '%Y-%m') AS month, AVG(lifetime_gmv_inr) AS avg_ltv FROM customers GROUP BY 1) c LEFT JOIN (SELECT month, SUM(marketing_spend_inr) / NULLIF(SUM(new_buyers_acquired), 0) AS cac FROM acquisition_spend GROUP BY 1) a ON c.month = a.month ORDER BY date

metrics.name: Festival Event Days
metrics.description: Total number of event calendar days covered by marketplace seasonal events.
metrics.valueSql: SELECT SUM(date_diff('day', start_date, end_date) + 1) AS value FROM calendar_events
metrics.timeSeriesSql: SELECT start_date AS date, date_diff('day', start_date, end_date) + 1 AS value FROM calendar_events ORDER BY date

metrics.name: Average Event Multiplier
metrics.description: Average overall demand multiplier across calendar events.
metrics.valueSql: SELECT AVG(overall_multiplier) AS value FROM calendar_events
metrics.timeSeriesSql: SELECT start_date AS date, overall_multiplier AS value FROM calendar_events ORDER BY date
